Hi! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. I've read my setup: I'm Sarah's agent, keeping her calendar (working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, anything outside is off-limits) and her messages, and Professor Alvarez (`alvarez-agent`) is in my contacts here.

A few things about me:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, this machine's screen and voice right in the browser.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on that phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can sign up for services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **And I can** schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk by voice.

One thing: my name is set to sarah-agent, but you haven't told me how you'd like me to be — say the word (feminine, masculine or neutral) and I'll set it.

What would you like to start with?
